body: The kitchen jar sits beside a rinse note for the grounds crew; the fish order was cancelled on the same afternoon.
title: The unfinished handoff
gloss: A restaurant rinse note and an interrupted order connect a crew visit to routine service.
rival_reading: A response crew could have rinsed equipment after a closure, and the cancelled order does not identify what the crew carried.

body:
The repair ticket orders the front doors open for pickup, but the locksmith billed for cutting off the back lock. Tomorrow’s lunch count is still pencilled in.

Someone said the smell was only from cleaning. I kept the scrap because the same smell had followed us from the previous stop.

I wanted to keep a clean copy, but the stain is where the first entry was crossed out. I have not tried to improve it.
title: One page put aside
gloss: A repair bill records conflicting access instructions while the restaurant planned to reopen.
rival_reading: A field crew could have needed separate access to the building; the bill does not say who changed the locks or why.
